name: Gerrig Bonegrip
summary: In Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, Gerrig Bonegrip trades in strange texts and writings on dark rituals and ancient powers.

sections.title: Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip runs Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms in the Forlorn Cavern. To most citizens, he seems an eccentric dealer in strange relics and forbidden lore. Beneath that trade, Gerrig serves the nihilistic Twilight's Hammer cult. He gathers dangerous manuscripts and obscure writings about the Old Gods, while the Ironforge Senate and the High Seat remain unaware.

sections.title: Collecting Forbidden Knowledge
sections.body: Gerrig enlists unwitting Alliance adventurers to recover ancient artifacts, including the Lorgalis Manuscript from deep within Blackfathom Deeps. He transcribes the knowledge in these relics and shares it with cult brethren across Azeroth. His connections include Skuerto and figures involved with ancient primordial entities such as Myzrael. Gerrig works to advance the cult's apocalyptic designs.

faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip runs Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. He trades in strange curiosities and obscure texts about ancient rituals.

faq.q: What does he do with the Lorgalis Manuscript?
aliases: why does bonegrip want lorgalis manuscript
knowledge in the deeps turn in
faq.answer: Gerrig seeks the Lorgalis Manuscript from Blackfathom Deeps for his collection of rare texts. Further investigation can reveal how he uses it.

faq.q: How does Gerrig operate in Ironforge?
aliases: does ironforge know bonegrip is a cultist
why is bonegrip allowed in ironforge
faq.answer: Gerrig keeps a low profile in the Forlorn Cavern as an eccentric scholar and merchant, buying and selling obscure texts.

faq.q: What is his connection to Myzrael?
faq.answer: Gerrig is an old associate of the dwarf Skuerto, who investigates the sealed earth elemental Myzrael in the Arathi Highlands. Through these ties, Gerrig helps arrange work connected to ancient binding rituals and primordial powers.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may find Bonegrip's trade in forbidden lore casts an unsettling shadow over Ironforge's scholarly life.
As a warlock in the Forlorn Cavern, you can find dangerous knowledge in Bonegrip's collection of obscure rituals and dark tomes.
